title: Gerald Ford — Born, Raised, And What Came After #Shorts
description:
What Gerald Ford wanted at the start and what Gerald Ford got are not the same thing, and that gap is the story. Gerald Rudolph Ford Jr. (born Leslie Lynch King Jr.; July 14, 1913 – December 26, 2006) was the 38th president of the United States, serving from 1974 to 1977. A member of the Republican Party, Ford previously served in the United States House of Representatives from 1949 to 1973.

The first real success of Gerald Ford arrived later than anyone expected, and changed everything. After one month of training, he went to Navy Preflight School in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, where he was one of 83 instructors and taught elementary navigation skills, ordnance, gunnery, first aid, and military drill. In addition, he coached all nine sports that were offered, but mostly swimming, boxing, and football.
